main_text.head: Futurum α.
Futurum β.
main_text.p: Notio. Simili modo flectῦtur Futura prima quartæ coniugationis, ψαλξμαι ψαλῇ ψαλεῖται. Etiam aliarum coniugationū more Dorico, τυψξμαι τυψῇ, &c.
Item φάγω, ἔδω, ψίω, Futurum secundum medium non circunflectunt, φάγομαι.

page.notes: Greek paradigm forms are printed in a Greek type with many accents and ligatures; the transcription of individual Greek forms is approximate and several may contain errors. The marginal Greek words φάγω, ἔδω, ψίω sit at left beside the last paragraph. The final word "φάγομαι" is partly cut off at the line end.
